title: The Crowned Beast
wikitext:
{{Infobox Quest |image= File:BotW The Crowned Beast.png |caption= |type= Shrine |game= BotW |giver= [[Kass]] |location= Rabia Plain |prereq= |reward= [[Mezza Lo Shrine]] |previous= |next= }} "{{Term/Store|The Crowned Beast||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Shrine Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|The Crowned Beast}}
{{Color BotW|Shrine Quest|Rabia Plain}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== On [[Rabia Plain]], [[Link]] can find [[Kass]] singing about a "crown of bone" near a [[Pedestal]].{{Cite|Crown of bone...|Kass|BotW}} He is shocked upon being interrupted,{{Cite|Oh! Pardon me! I didn't think anyone was around...|Kass|BotW}} but his demeanor becomes friendly once he recognizes Link.{{Cite|Ah, I knew we'd meet again!
Though, I never imagined it would be here...|Kass|BotW}} He reveals that he knows an "[[Ancient Song]]" about the area,{{Cite|I know a song about this place.|Kass|BotW}} and he asks Link if he would like to listen.{{Cite|Would you like to hear the ancient verse passed down in this region?|Kass|BotW}} When Link agrees to hear the song, Kass will sing it for him.{{Cite|[Let's hear it.] Excellent! Without further ado...|Kass|BotW}} The lyrics of Kass's song describe placing a beast with a bone crown upon a throne, which will reveal an [[Ancient Shrine]].{{Cite|A beast that wears a crown of bone,
Prancing through the lush green.
Mount the beast upon its throne,
For only then the shrine is seen.|Kass|BotW}} Though Kass believes that the area is correct, he does not know what kind of creature wears a "crown of bone".{{Cite|I suppose "the lush green" could refer to this place. But what sort of beast wears a "crown of bone"?|Kass|BotW}} He knows there is a secret, but he is not sure he can solve it.{{Cite|There's definitely a secret hiding here, but it's beyond me.|Kass|BotW}} He wishes Link well on his journey,{{Cite|May the light illuminate your path.|Kass|BotW}} and the [[Shrine Quest]] begins. To unearth the Ancient Shrine, Link needs to successfully mount and tame a [[Mountain Buck]].{{Cite|The beast wearing a crown of bone was a mountain buck.|Adventure Log|BotW}} These [[Deer]] can be found throughout Rabia Plain, but Link must have a high [[Stealth]] level in order to approach one without it running away. After successfully taming a Mountain Buck, Link can ride it onto the Pedestal, which will activate it, and [[Mezza Lo Shrine]] to emerge from the ground.{{Cite|As the song instructed, being atop a mountain buck while it stood on the pedestal caused the shrine to appear.|Adventure Log|BotW}} After this, the Shrine Quest will be completed. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | "A beast that wears a crown of bone,
Prancing through the lush green.
Mount the beast upon its throne,
For only then the shrine is seen."

This is a song that Kass sang. Solve the song's riddle to find the shrine. |- | Complete | "A beast that wears a crown of bone,
Prancing through the lush green.
Mount the beast upon its throne,
For only then the shrine is seen."

The beast wearing a crown of bone was a mountain buck.

As the song instructed, being atop a mountain buck while it stood on the pedestal caused the shrine to appear. }} ==Trivia== * ''[[Kass's Journal]]'', which is located in a hut on [[Washa's Bluff]], hints at this Shrine Quest.{{Cite|"The ancient song of {{Color BotW|Blue|Rabia Plain}}."|Kass's Journal|BotW}} Kass recounts that Rabia Plain is supposedly the setting for an ancient song about a beast,{{Cite|Apparently Rabia Plain in the northern part of Hateno is home to an ancient song about beasts.|Kass's Journal|BotW}} and he plans on stopping by [[Kakariko Village]] before investigating.{{Cite|Rabia Plain is northeast of {{Color BotW|Blue|Kakariko Village}}. I'll likely stop by the village during my search for the song.|Kass's Journal|BotW}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Mezza Lo Shrine.png|Mezza Lo Shrine ==See Also== {{See Also| * Kass * Mezza Lo Shrine * Rabia Plain * Shrine Quest }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |shrine-quests= BotW }}
